verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers multi-currency cash accounts with yield, manual FX conversion between accounts, and balance review via its MCP server. Nothing in the evidence documents automatic top-up rules between accounts or low-balance alerts. Its webhooks cover card transaction events only, and scheduled payments are one-off future-dated sends, not recurring balance-driven sweeps.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can automate cash management with auto top-up between accounts and low-balance alerts
